reviews.title: awesome 280mm cooler
reviews.comment: I had to do a warranty around 2 years into having the device NZXT was fantastic contacted me and processed a warranty on the device paid for shipping and replaced it with a brand new device ..Excellent service.
reviews.author: John Beck

reviews.title: Great product, splitter cable provided not compatible with Lian Li
reviews.comment: Purchased with the lian li 24 and 8 pin. Ran out of ports for the kraken to set lcd screen to desired image. Writing this review to serve as a caution. If you plan on using more than the 2 ports provided by the MOBO get a splitter/hub. The provided NZXT splitter is not compatible with my lian li strimmer cable.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: It keeps my really expensive CPU cool enough where it doesn’t take damage over long time and will last an extremely long lifetime and they’re relatively good priced for having a screen on them

reviews.comment: Sometimes the screen doesn’t work, and I have to manually reset it in NZXT Can, also does not work with Linux.

reviews.title: Fan rpg underwhelming
reviews.comment: Its working great EXCEPT for the RGB on the fans,its keeping my new am5 rig nice and cool but the only Rgb component i can access to adjust is the pump lcd screen set up if there is a way its not very intuitive, ive owned on of these before and hand no problems then. I bought it again as i had good results LAST TIME across the board before and  to give the case lighting some pop in the new rig and am more than a little DISAPPOINTED with the so far UNDERWHELMING fan rpg options with this aio
